tabs.text: Observed the candidate homepage/access chooser, public Research and Care paths, business/organization/affiliate/supplier information, signed-out account and partner gates, synthetic active/empty/paused customer accounts, and admin entry gates. The chooser separates inquiry from account approval and Care routing. Not every CTA or persona lifecycle is qualified. Missing real tokens, production-equivalent customer histories and privileged fixtures remain NOT RUN; an observed link is not an exercised workflow.

tabs.text: Candidate /research/order explains five pathways; /research/early-access and the assisted request entry render in a bounded preview. Formal membership apply/review/success remain closed. Catalog data in this preview is synthetic/fallback and cannot qualify exact products, pricing, ordering, payment or fulfillment. Native commerce remains disabled; no ordering gate was opened.

tabs.title: 03 Care
tabs.text: Browser observations cover public Care, schedule, portal, how-it-works, provider review, support, eligibility, consent, appointments, prescriptions and pharmacy. Existing Care contact regression tests pass in the focused repair run.

tabs.text: Signed-out dashboard shows a clear sign-in gate and preserves the dashboard return destination. No partner approval or economic promise was inferred.

tabs.title: 05 B2B + Organizations
tabs.text: Current candidate inquiries do transmit through POST /api/contact; the older local-summary-only description is historical. The existing contract is email-owned, with no durable inquiry row or status page. Browser AUD-001 proves that a 200 response previously claimed receipt despite no provider. Repair 02d525b awaits team-email acceptance, fails honestly when unavailable, and treats courtesy-confirmation failure separately. Provider acceptance is not inbox delivery or review. No CRM, queue, schema or second account authority was added.

tabs.title: 06 Account + Orders + Payment
tabs.text: Synthetic active-account browser navigation covers commerce history, billing history, Care status, interests, documents, profile, security and support. Partial history is labeled unavailable rather than definitive zero. Empty-account states preserve completeness limits; a paused account cannot reopen itself. Support submission appears in fixture memory only; the fixture timestamp is epoch-based and is not evidence of a production date defect. Real invoice/proof/manual verification/settlement/fulfillment and cross-owner production data remain unverified. No money moved.

tabs.title: 07 Admin + Operations
tabs.text: All static admin route declarations were inventoried and their signed-out entry states observed. Shell navigation is visible; operational data/actions require admin access. A separate bounded fixture uses the actual requireSupabaseAdmin guard with synthetic identities: seeded question queue/detail and synthetic reply succeeded; a non-admin identity was denied. External sockets and fetches are blocked by the harness, and notifications remain memory intents. This is not proof of production ADMIN_EMAIL, every queue or founder-wide permissions. Other admin transitions remain NOT RUN.

tabs.title: 08 Notifications + Next Steps
tabs.text: A UI success must match the underlying authority. AUD-001 distinguishes team-provider acceptance, optional courtesy-provider acceptance, inbox delivery, durable storage and human review. Only the first two are addressed by the narrow contact repair. Failure preserves the draft and names a direct email fallback; courtesy-only failure does not invite duplicate inquiry submission. Existing account, partner, Care, order and outbox authorities remain separate. Real delivery, bounce handling, retry and operator notification coverage are not established by this browser run.
